name: chalette-dev
description: Chalette internal dev & QA toolkit for Command Room. v0.1.3 (2026-07-15): bug-regression-suite catalog +1 entry — Bug #105 (_pid_alive fired a real Ctrl+C on Windows; os.kill(pid,0) == CTRL_C_EVENT, blocked the Windows battery outright and defeated multi_write_context mutual exclusion under Cowork's no-console path; cr1 ae399e8 / PR #30). First code-level catalog entry: the battery is the repro, not a prompt fire. NOTE: this diverges the catalog from the private chalette plugin (v0.8.10) until M mirrors it — the byte-identical invariant is intentionally broken here and needs a sync. v0.1.2 (2026-07-14): bug-regression-suite catalog +3 integration-2026-07 entries (F-15 widget-transport instruction gap, F-08 no-email inference ban, F-12 apply-choices non-Gmail substrate writes), Bug #104 update (delegation confirmed live; EW2+T pass criteria), instruction-layer Methodology note — catalog stays byte-identical with the private chalette plugin (v0.8.10). 16 skills extracted from the private chalette plugin (v0.8.8, 2026-07-13): release verification (verify-cr-release, ship-readiness-gate, synthetic-workspace-runtime-test, compare-canonical-vs-freelance), test batteries (cr-test, run-command-room-tests, bug-regression-suite, cross-skill-interaction-test, scale-stress-test, smoke-watch), skill building (cr-skill-builder, skill-creator, skill-generator, regenerate-skill, voice-test), and preview-command-room-widget. Operator-aware: reads config/operator.json for identity, paths, and permitted test targets — non-M operators always test against synthetic fixtures, never a real workspace. Shipping/promote (ship-cr-plugin) deliberately NOT included — releases stay with M.
